title: Peer and ART code-review cycle
summary: CS2 through advanced students bring a prior Java object-oriented assignment into a seven-phase code-review activity. They review peers, annotate an undisclosed GPT-generated review of their own code, reflect on its usefulness, then conduct a second peer review to apply what they learned.

sources.title: WIP: ARTful Insights from a Pilot Study on GPT-Based Automatic Code Reviews in Undergraduate Computer Science Programs
sources.evidence_quote: The study had seven phases ... asking them to perform code reviews, reading an ART-derived review on their own code, and then performing another code review with writing reflections.

assessment.summary: Write two GitHub-style peer code reviews around an intervention in which students annotate and evaluate an AI review of their own Java code.
student_actions: Review a peer's Java assignment in a pull request.
Annotate AI review suggestions as usable, understandable but unusable, or not understood.
Review a second peer project and explain changes in approach.
